One out-of-line destructor definition makes mwcc emit three variants -- under `#pragma defer_codegen off` in the order D1, D0, D2 -- but the cartridge carries only D1 (0x020aee40, 0x48) and D0 (0x020aee88, 0x5c). No address anywhere in config/ names a D2 for this class: config/arm9/overlays/ov002/symbols.txt has no such row and the scout's fact file records the variant set as D1/D0 with no D2. It therefore has no ROM home -- plain `deadstrip`, not `deadstrip-duplicate` -- and production isolation discards it. It is emitted after D0 and before ordinal 2, so it does not disturb the licensed run: verify reports all 36 licensed functions in the expected ROM-ascending section order with it present.
